$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
BASE='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png'
OUTPUT='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_horizontal_bisector_10px.png'
test -f "$BASE"
test ! -e "$OUTPUT"
test "$(sha256sum "$BASE" | awk '{print $1}')" = 'ae82854dcee417bec13dbfdb305b97239059c0dbd78387f6347c2f60267a5b58'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-line-venv
/tmp/fishfry-line-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry-line-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageChops
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
base=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png')
output=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_horizontal_bisector_10px.png')
with Image.open(base) as im:
    orig=im.convert('RGB')
assert orig.size == (1448,1448), orig.size
out=orig.copy()
# For even 1448-pixel height, exact midpoint is between rows 723 and 724.
# Ten-pixel black band therefore covers rows 719 through 728 inclusive.
ImageDraw.Draw(out).rectangle((0,719,1447,728),fill=(0,0,0))
assert out.size==(1448,1448)
assert all(out.getpixel((x,y))==(0,0,0) for x in (0,724,1447) for y in range(719,729))
assert ImageChops.difference(out.crop((0,0,1448,719)),orig.crop((0,0,1448,719))).getbbox() is None
assert ImageChops.difference(out.crop((0,729,1448,1448)),orig.crop((0,729,1448,1448))).getbbox() is None
out.save(output,'PNG',compress_level=6)
print('OUTPUT',output,'SIZE',out.size,'BLACK_LINE_Y_INCLUSIVE',(719,728),'THICKNESS',10,'BYTES',output.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$OUTPUT"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Overlay centered ten-pixel horizontal bisector on pizza screen'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6;do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main;then
    printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$OUTPUT" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
    printf 'LOCAL_BLOB ';git hash-object "$OUTPUT"
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'FAILED_TO_PUBLISH' >&2
exit 1
